title: Rising Artist Captain Brick Delivers His Latest Release Titled “Deepend”
htmlContent:
American-based artist Captain Brick is a multi-talented artist and songwriter who makes music with rhymes with the ultimate focus that can't be denied in his new song “Deepend.” With a calm yet commanding energy in his approach that makes you feel the conviction in the rhyming that comes to life.

One thing that shines through strongly with his song is that it is incredibly consistent with his style. Captain Brick does not play around when it comes to expressing her emotions. The song is about people's emotions when things get too much, and they start to feel like they are drowning.
